title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike
summary_full: Real Madrid player Vinícius Jr sent a surprise message to 13-year-old fan Zaher who lost both his legs after being hit by a drone in Khartoum, in 2024.
